raw.query: WITH current_dim AS (SELECT d.run_id, d.policy, d.window_name, d.is_current, d.superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim d WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL), pairs(policy, arm, sim_run_id) AS (VALUES ('reactive'::text, 'live_re'::text, 'live:twin_re'::text), ('forecast'::text, 'live_fc'::text, 'live:twin_fc_p90'::text)), breakdown AS (SELECT p.policy, l.arm, l.request_count AS live_request_count, l.ttft_p99_ms AS live_ttft_p99_ms, i.run_id AS sim_run_id, i.n_requests AS sim_request_count, i.achieved_p99_ms AS sim_ttft_p99_ms, ABS(l.ttft_p99_ms - i.achieved_p99_ms) / i.achieved_p99_ms * 100.0 AS pct_diff_vs_sim, d.window_name, d.is_current AS dim_is_current, i.is_current AS infraction_is_current, d.superseded_by FROM pairs p JOIN provenance.v_live_anchor l ON l.arm = p.arm AND l.policy = p.policy JOIN current_dim d ON d.run_id = p.sim_run_id JOIN provenance.v_infraction i ON i.run_id = d.run_id AND i.is_current = true AND i.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND i.bound_stat = 'p99') SELECT policy, arm, live_request_count, live_ttft_p99_ms, sim_run_id, sim_request_count, sim_ttft_p99_ms, pct_diff_vs_sim, window_name, dim_is_current, infraction_is_current, superseded_by, COUNT(*) OVER () AS denominator_policies, MIN(pct_diff_vs_sim) OVER () AS min_pct_diff, MAX(pct_diff_vs_sim) OVER () AS max_pct_diff FROM breakdown ORDER BY policy
